finding.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')
finding.summary: An attacker-controlled failed_sender value from a webhook form field is concatenated directly into a raw SMTP MAIL FROM command issued via smtplib's low-level docmd()/putcmd() layer, bypassing sendmail()'s own address validation and allowing CRLF in the address to inject an additional SMTP command into the envelope.
